title: Swiss Tourist Sentenced to Prison After Violating ‘Day of Silence’ in Bali
summary_full: The 26-year-old received a yearlong sentence from a court on the Indonesian resort island after he flouted a sacred Hindu ritual and insulted it on Instagram.
